baseline.equivalence_test: all three arms use registered Top-50 snapshots, exactly five unique members, ascending original retrieval-rank context order, and one frozen Generator identity

core_invariants: Reuse only the registered nq_open validation[1950:2000] and validation[3150:3200] case-study and evidence-panel hashes.
Perform zero retrieval and zero Answer Scorer calls; never download Wiki-DPR.
Treat three-model labels as gold-answer-conditioned L0 silver diagnostics that may affect only the oracle arm.
Preserve stored QORE and Top-k membership exactly, while reordering every arm by the same original retrieval-rank rule before generation.
Use the same frozen Generator model, revision, prompt path, decoding, and evaluator for exactly 300 calls.
Complete questions, passages, answers, predictions, and membership ids remain exchange-only; GitHub receives only compact privacy-valid files at most 1 MiB.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: registered nq_open validation[1950:2000] and validation[3150:3200] stored Top-50 traces
reproducibility.environment: Record git revision, config/plan hashes, source hashes, Python, resolved Generator identity, output hashes, and timing.

selector_responsiveness.action_if_pass: prioritize a deployable gold-free selector that approximates oracle membership; no claim promotion
selector_responsiveness.action_if_borderline: inspect selector-responsive and Generator-unresponsive strata before one bounded refinement
selector_responsiveness.action_if_fail: do not optimize silver evidence retention as a surrogate for final F1

limitations: This fixed-100 oracle experiment is L0 diagnostic only.
The three-model labels were conditioned on gold answers and therefore cannot enter a deployable selector.
A positive ceiling validates selector headroom through the frozen Generator, not the generalization or novelty of any online mechanism.
A negative result challenges the silver evidence surrogate or Generator responsiveness; it does not prove retrieval quality.
